subject: pathology
title: Alpha-1 Globules, Primary Biliary and Sclerosing Cholangitis, and Hepatic Adenoma

steps.tx: Alpha-1 antitrypsin Z protein polymerises inside hepatocyte endoplasmic reticulum as PAS positive diastase resistant globules, injuring liver by retention while lungs suffer from circulating deficiency. Those globules diagnose **hepatic alpha-1 antitrypsin accumulation (PiZZ liver disease)**. This point is tested repeatedly because it changes everyday bedside decisions.
steps.say: PAS positive globules that resist diastase are trapped alpha-1 protein injuring the liver that made it.

vis.caption: Electrophoresis patterns where alpha-1 deficiency first betrays itself.

steps.tx: Primary biliary cholangitis autoimmune destroys small intrahepatic ducts in middle aged women with antimitochondrial antibodies, itching, fatigue, and cholestatic enzymes progressing toward biliary cirrhosis. The small duct disease is **primary biliary cholangitis (PBC)**. Examiners return to it because it separates careful clinicians from guesswork.
steps.say: Itching, cholestasis, and antimitochondrial antibodies in a middle aged woman mean primary biliary cholangitis.

vis.caption: Primary biliary cholangitis with small duct loss and cholestatic progression.

steps.tx: Ursodeoxycholic acid improves transplant free survival in PBC when alkaline phosphatase responds, second line obeticholic acid and fibrates serving incomplete responders by biochemical criteria. Response grading is **UDCA response assessment in primary biliary cholangitis**. Bedside recognition of this pattern saves time, blood, and unnecessary investigation.
steps.say: Judge UDCA by alkaline phosphatase response at a year; incomplete responders earn second line therapy.

steps.tx: Primary sclerosing cholangitis scars intra and extrahepatic ducts into beaded strictures, strongly married to ulcerative colitis, risking cholangiocarcinoma and colorectal cancer surveillance duties. The beaded duct disease is **primary sclerosing cholangitis (PSC)**. Students should anchor this fact before moving to rarer causes and exceptions.
steps.say: Beaded ducts plus ulcerative colitis equal primary sclerosing cholangitis; cancers shadow both organs.

vis.caption: Primary sclerosing cholangitis with beaded bile duct strictures.

steps.tx: Dominant PSC strictures dilate endoscopically while new strictures earn brushings and imaging against cholangiocarcinoma, whose early detection remains PSC care's hardest problem. That vigilance is **cholangiocarcinoma surveillance in primary sclerosing cholangitis**. In practice this distinction decides the next test, treatment, or referral made.
steps.say: A new dominant stricture in PSC is cholangiocarcinoma until brushings, imaging, and time acquit it.

steps.tx: Hepatic adenoma, benign hepatocyte neoplasm of young women on oestrogen, bleeds or rarely transforms by subtype, HNF1 alpha and beta catenin patterns guiding resection thresholds. Subtype rules management: **hepatic adenoma subtyping and resection thresholds**. That is why this detail earns its place in every examination and ward round.
steps.say: Stop oestrogen, subtype the adenoma, resect by size sex and beta catenin; hepatic adenomas obey rules.

steps.tx: Adenoma rupture haemorrhages into liver or peritoneum in pregnancy and large subcapsular lesions, embolisation stabilising before staged resection decisions. That emergency is **ruptured hepatic adenoma management**. Remembering it prevents the commonest errors made with this presentation entirely. Pathologists weigh this pattern beside clinical history because neither alone separates the causes reliably.
steps.say: A young woman collapsing with liver haemorrhage may be bleeding from an adenoma; embolise first.

steps.tx: Cholestatic pattern synthesis closes the lesson: duct size, antibodies, bowel associations, drug history, and imaging separate PBC, PSC, IgG4 disease, obstruction, and DILI before biopsy. That synthesis is **cholestatic liver pattern workup**. The clinical payoff comes from applying it early, before complications accumulate further.
steps.say: Small duct, large duct, drug, or stone: cholestasis sorts by duct geography before biopsy speaks.
